# Morton's The Steakhouse

> > Morton's The Steakhouse is an upscale fine dining steakhouse chain serving USDA Prime-Aged Beef and premium seafood, with locations across the United States and franchised internationally.

Founded in 1978 in Chicago by Arnie Morton and Klaus Fritsch, Morton's has grown to over 65 locations offering signature steaks, seafood, Bar 12-21 cocktails, private dining rooms, and catering services. The restaurant is known for its Wine Spectator-awarded wine program, Landry's Select Club loyalty program, and special Prime Events featuring winemaker dinners.
